''See also: [[Elder (Elder Empire) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Elders]] are ancient, eternal, and alien entities that possess immense power over fundamental forces such as time, space, knowledge, life, and death. While some believe they are merely myths or extinct, they remain a present threat to humanity, often described as unknowable horrors. They are categorized into different levels, including [[Great Elders]]—sometimes referred to as [[Class One Fiends]]—and their various offspring known as [[Elderspawn]]. [[Great Elders]] are unique beings with specific, driving purposes: for example, [[Urg’naut]] seeks annihilation, [[Nakothi]] pursues a balance of life and death, [[Tharlos, the Formless Legion{{!}}Tharlos]] desires change, [[Kthanikahr]] aims to replace humanity with worms, and [[Ach'magut{{!}}Ach’magut]] seeks knowledge. They are known to travel between worlds through a void, which also serves as their home and a means of communication. Historically, the [[Elders]] ruled the world before the rise of human civilization. Although they built great civilizations during their reign, they also enslaved humanity. Following a period of conflict known as the [[Elder War]], the [[Great Elders]] were largely defeated or driven into a sleeping state, allowing for the establishment of [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]]. However, they are not truly gone; many remain active or are slowly awakening to reclaim their former dominion. They often attempt to corrupt human leadership to gain control over the species, and their influence can be felt through the manipulation of global events. Humanity interacts with these entities in various ways. The [[Blackwatch]] serves as a primary defense, studying Elder biology and attempting to contain them. Some groups, like the [[Sleepless]], seek to communicate with [[Great Elders]] to gain their wisdom for the benefit of mankind. Others utilize [[Elderspawn]] or bound [[Elders]] to assist with tasks like navigation across the [[Aion Sea]]. The Emperor has historically maintained stability by utilizing Elder-derived powers, such as immortality, to stand above humanity. Despite these efforts, the [[Elders]] remain a constant source of instability, with many fearing that their eventual full awakening will lead to the destruction of human civilization.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[The Elder]] is a potent force of power contained within [[Jerri's Vessel]]. These entities possess the ability to capsize entire ships and can manifest as rapidly growing flesh upon walls that serves to heal wounds. While they are formidable, they can be restrained through the use of [[invested chains]]. It is important to note that the sparks witnessed by [[Urzaia Woodsman{{!}}Urzaia]] do not originate from an Elder.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Chains can be invested to restrain an Elder.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c2">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Elders]] can manifest as flesh on walls that grows rapidly and heals wounds.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c6">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The sparks seen by [[Urzaia Woodsman{{!}}Urzaia]] are not Elder.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c7">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Elder is a type of power found in [[Jerri's Vessel]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Elders]] are powerful entities that can capsize ships.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c21">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
